text:
Aria (Marketing): Need a compact, field-ready battle-lantern (1-pager AE + SDR pocket-card) and an inbound routing spine for the benchmark/webinar push. Goal: quick triage, route high-cost risk to AE, and a single sentence competitive hook vs cloud APIs.
Max (Product): Callouts: p95 under burst, identical API across modes, and the fallback ladder (hosted -> dedicated -> lite-quant). I9ll export a microbench CSV with notes on kernel-choice and quant profiles.
Sam (Sales): SDR pocket (3 lines): 1) "What's your inference bill look like at scale?" 2) "We provide serving primitives across cloud/dedicated/private." 3) quick rebuttal vs managed APIs: "Managed endpoints hide serving surprises until prod."
Rhea (Growth): Routing pseudocode for ops (HubSpot):
```
score = 0.6*norm(est_tokens) + 0.3*norm(company.ARR) + 0.1*(role=='engineer')
if (score>=0.8) route='ae-enterprise'
else if (form.interest=='webinar') route='webinar-funnel'
else route='marketing-nurture'
```
Add hidden field: est_tokens (slider) and checkbox for private-deploy interest.
ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled Fri 09:00 PT. CI: https://ci.redwood/deploy/998 (green).
Aria (Marketing): One-liner to test vs cloud APIs: "Cloud APIs give you models fast; Redwood gives you predictable serving when customers go live." Short, please.
Max (Product): Include microbench table header suggestion: [env, seq_len, p95_ms, tokens_per_USD] and annotate batch/quant caveats.
Sam (Sales): AE slide line: "Predictable serving, predictable cost." Will prep procurement bullets: pricing options, SLA tiers, data residency.
Rhea (Growth): I'll wire the HubSpot mapping and test the A/B CTAs: "Join webinar" vs "Get your cost estimate". For score>=0.8 surface AE calendar link.
Aria (Marketing): Owners & deadlines: Max -> bench + battle-lantern; Sam -> SDR + procurement; Rhea -> routing + CTA tests; Aria -> slides + webinar copy. Drafts by Mon EOD. Ping me if anything slips. :rocket:
